Machine Learning & AI Internship
description:
WHY this position is important

Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it.

The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot: automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible.

These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production.

HOW you will contribute

You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor.

Every topic follows the same path:

  • Evaluation first: in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter.

  • A baseline in production: you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3.

  • Then go further: you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result.

You will own the topic end to end: understanding the problem with accountants and product teams, defining success metrics, building, measuring and presenting your results.

Topics for 2027

Here is an overview of the topics we want to staff in 2027. We agree on the final topic and your tutor with you.

  • Reading invoices and new types of documents with compact vision-language models (VLMs): fine-tuning, supervision from e-invoices, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

  • Knowing when the AI is right: calibrated confidence, selective automation and model routing for automated accounting decisions.

  • Evaluating accounting agents: an open benchmark of long-horizon accounting tasks on simulated client files, with verifiable scoring.

  • Learning from accountants' corrections: turning feedback into editable rules, with non-regression guarantees.

  • Bank reconciliation: matching one transaction to several documents, as learned graph optimisation.

  • An AI agent for Autopilot support tickets: from investigation to a pull request. This is an applied topic for profiles who prefer building systems close to production.

  • Data foundations for AI: evaluation datasets, data quality and monitoring, and agents that let teams query and use data on their own.

AI will be part of how you work

You will use coding assistants and AI agents every day: to explore the codebase and data models, write Python and SQL, run experiments, write tests and debug.

We expect you to give agents the right context and to check their output. You own the result, not the agent.

OUR CULTURE

You will join a hands-on engineering culture, where two technical co-founders are still among the most active contributors to the codebase.

You will work with ML and AI engineers, data specialists, software engineers, product managers and accountants. You will have strong mentorship and a lot of ownership: freedom to test ideas, challenge existing approaches and build things from scratch, with an R&D mindset.

The goal is not a demo. It is something the team can trust, reuse and ship.

YOU'RE THE RIGHT CANDIDATE IF YOU

  • Are in the final year of a Master's degree or engineering school in machine learning, computer science, statistics or applied mathematics. Research internships of at least 4 months are also considered.

  • Have strong ML foundations and solid Python, and have already trained, fine-tuned or evaluated models in academic, personal or professional projects.

  • Care about evaluation: clean baselines, reproducible experiments and metrics that reflect the real problem.

  • Are comfortable with real-world data: SQL, analysis, messy and imbalanced datasets.

  • Already use AI ambitiously in your projects and can explain how you verify its output.

  • Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a multidisciplinary team. No accounting knowledge is required, only curiosity.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

  • Duration: 5 to 6 months (final-year internship).

  • Start date: March or April 2027.

  • Location: Paris office, at least 3 days per week on site, together with your tutor.

  • Supervision: a dedicated tutor from the ML & AI team.

  • Resources: GPUs, API access to frontier models, real data under GDPR-compliant conditions, and our existing evaluation infrastructure.

  • After the internship: an opportunity to join Pennylane full-time on a permanent contract.

HOW TO APPLY

Please send us:

  • Your CV.

  • Links to relevant projects: GitHub repositories, technical reports, notebooks or papers.

  • A few lines on your motivation and the topics that interest you most.

Marketing & AI Intern

Thermeleon | Internship | The Netherlands

About Thermeleon

Thermeleon is a technology-driven company working at the intersection of energy, technology and sustainable horticulture. We develop innovative solutions that contribute to a more sustainable greenhouse industry while helping reduce pressure on the electricity grid.

We are a growing team with big ambitions, and we're looking for someone who wants to help shape how Thermeleon presents itself to the world.

The role

We're looking for a creative, proactive and tech-savvy Marketing Intern who wants to take ownership and build things from the ground up.

You'll work on refreshing our brand, developing marketing materials and building our digital marketing infrastructure using modern AI tools such as Claude Code.

You'll have the opportunity to combine creativity, marketing strategy and technology, while seeing your work directly impact a growing company.

What you'll be working on

1. Brand Refresh

  • Help refine and strengthen the Thermeleon brand identity.

  • Develop a consistent visual and communication style.

  • Translate our brand positioning into a compelling brand experience.

2. Marketing Materials

  • Update and develop our marketing materials, including presentations, brochures, one-pagers and other sales collateral.

  • Create visual content for internal and external communication.

  • Ensure consistency across all marketing touchpoints.

3. Build the Thermeleon Website with Claude Code

  • Take part in rebuilding and developing the Thermeleon website using Claude Code.

  • Translate ideas and designs into functional web pages.

  • Improve website structure, user experience and content.

  • Explore how AI can accelerate website development.

4. Build a Content Marketing Machine with Claude Code

  • Help build a scalable content marketing system using AI.

  • Develop workflows for content creation, planning and distribution.

  • Create a content calendar and establish a consistent publishing rhythm.

  • Explore AI-powered tools and automations to make marketing more efficient.

Who we're looking for

  • You're studying Marketing, Communication, Creative Business, Digital Media, or a related field.

  • You're creative, curious and entrepreneurial.

  • You have an interest in AI, technology and digital tools.

  • You're excited about experimenting with tools like Claude Code (coding experience is a plus, but not a requirement).

  • You have an eye for design, branding and visual communication.

  • You take initiative and enjoy turning ideas into reality.

  • You're comfortable working independently and taking ownership of projects.

  • You have excellent communication skills in English.

  • Speaking Dutch is a plus

What we offer

  • A hands-on internship where you'll have real ownership and responsibility.

  • The opportunity to build the marketing foundation of a growing technology company.

  • Freedom to experiment with AI and emerging technologies.

  • A close-knit, ambitious and international team.

  • Plenty of room to learn, experiment and bring your own ideas to life.

  • An internship compensation of €400 per month.

Interested?

We'd love to hear from you!

Send us your CV and a short introduction explaining why this internship interests you.

title: Abnormal: AI Security Sales Executive, TOLA
description: Headquarters: Remote - USA *Ideal candidates will reside in the Dallas, Austin or Houston area. ABOUT THE ROLE AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market. The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will work alongside the Account Executives who know our customers best: joining land motions, driving AI Security expansion across our 5,000+ customers, and running focused outbound to win net new logos in the largest enterprises. Early on, most of your focus will be expansion. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it. The timing matters. Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up regularly in customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. You will have real say in how this category gets sold. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Own AI Security in your region. Carry the AI Security quota and run the sales cycle from first conversation through close. • Drive expansion across our customer base. Lead upsell campaigns into customers who already trust Abnormal, and join land motions where AI Security belongs in the conversation. • Run focused pipeline generation. Build a targeted, strategic outbound motion to open net new logos in the largest enterprises, partnering with the core AE where a relationship exists. Quality over volume. • Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your region, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most. • Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on AI governance, agent security, and cloud security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch. • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table. • Shape the product and the playbook. Work directly with Product and R&D leadership, including our co-founder and CTO, and feed what you hear in the field back in a fast loop as the suite matures from early availability to GA. • Build AI Security expertise across the sales team, in addition to closing. • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace. WHAT YOU'LL SELL Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability: • AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost. • AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots. • AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions. • AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended. • AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open. For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of personal quota attainment and winning new business. • Hands-on experience selling an AI product, with enough technical and product depth to run the sales cycle as the expert and give our product team credible feedback. • A record of selling in security or closely adjacent infrastructure. • Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers. • A consultative, challenger style, paired with the hunter instincts to run strategic outbound into new logos. • Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on. • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints. NICE TO HAVES • • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories. • Experience as an early seller or builder of a new motion: a first sales hire, a founding seller, or a new product line launched inside a larger company. • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders. • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals. Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Base salary range: $157,250 — $185,000 USD A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards. Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. title: SweetSpot Heating and Cooling: Creative Strategist (AI-Native, Direct Response)
description: Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale. About the role We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch. This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend. What you will do • Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research. • Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency. • Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad. • Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad. • Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named. • Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round. • Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows. What we are looking for • Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them. • A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations. • Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses. • AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how. • Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads. • Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed. • Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here. Pay and structure • Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience. • Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads. • Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales. Our hiring process (exactly how it works) • Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow). • Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete. • Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario. • Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more. • Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30. We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

title: Working Student Data & AI (m/f/d)
description:
About BetterDoc

We are BetterDoc, a digital health company with more than 200 employees in Cologne and Basel. We support patients with serious illnesses and complex diagnoses in finding the right specialists for their health concerns. To do this, we bundle, structure and analyze quality-relevant data from the healthcare sector. Since 2012, we have supported more than 100,000 patients. We have been part of the Otto Group since 2022 and work closely with our sister company Medgate, one of Europe's leading telemedicine providers.

You study medicine and are already exploring what AI can do? With us, you bring both together. You test prompts for real data requests, review AI outputs with your medical knowledge and help build small prototypes. And you see how they turn into products.

Our team

Medical Science is the medical core of BetterDoc. We turn medical knowledge into products: structured data, decision logic and, more and more, AI. Our physicians build prototypes themselves and take them live together with Product and Engineering. As a working student, you are part of this team.

We are looking for a working student (m/f/d) to join us as soon as possible, based in Cologne or remote.

Your mission

Day-to-day work

  • Maintain our medical database: Keep our medical database up to date through targeted research, structured data preparation and systematic validation.
  • Analyses and reporting: Contribute to analyses of medical data for internal decisions.
  • Improve processes: Help develop and automate the workflows and concepts around our database.

AI and prototypes

  • Develop prompts and prototypes: Write and test prompts and build small tools together with the team, for example with Claude, Python, SQL or Google Apps Script.
  • Review AI outputs medically: Assess the results of our AI applications, help build test and reference datasets, and find errors before they reach patients.
  • Structure medical knowledge: Turn medical information into structured data and classifications such as ICD, OPS and SNOMED CT.
  • Work with the product team: Bring your medical perspective to the development of our internal systems with Product and Engineering, and see how a prototype becomes a product.

Your profile

  • You study medicine and are enrolled at a German university, ideally in the clinical phase.
  • You have a soft spot for AI: You already use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor, and maybe you have even built something of your own.
  • Technical curiosity: First experience with SQL, Python or databases is a plus, not a requirement.
  • You are confident with spreadsheets in Excel or Google Sheets.
  • You work carefully, in a structured and precise way and keep track even of larger datasets.
  • Fluent German and good English.
  • You enjoy working in a team and also independently.

What BetterDoc offers you

  • AI tools and time to experiment – Work with modern AI tools such as Claude and Claude Code, with room to try out new ideas.
  • Learn from physicians who build – Work closely with our Medical Science team and discover a career path beyond the clinic.
  • Flexible alongside your studies – Your hours fit around semesters, exams and clinical electives. Remote work is possible.
  • Make a real impact – Help patients find the right specialists more easily.
  • A strong backing – Work for a successful digital health company, supported by Medgate and the Otto Group.
  • Further benefits – Office in the heart of Cologne (dogs welcome), team events, modern hardware, subsidized Deutschland-Ticket, Urban Sports Club contribution, corporate benefits and a company pension plan (bAV) with a 30% employer contribution.
  • For you and your family – Free access to BetterDoc and the Medgate video consultation service at any time.

title: AI Engineering, Growth
Site Operations Coordinator
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Site Operations Coordinator, you are the daily face of the Wissous site and the owner of the on-site experience for everyone who works or visits there. You manage service providers, handle on-site requests and keep the site clean, welcoming and well run. You work closely with the Workplace team, Operations, IT and Marketing, with a high degree of autonomy and ownership.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure a smooth, consistent daily experience for all personnel working on site.

  • Oversee shared services and common areas, including cleaning, snacking and connected fridge services.

  • Manage on-site service providers day to day, monitor service quality against contractual commitments and escalate performance issues.

  • Act as the first point of contact for on-site requests, logging, tracking and closing tickets.

  • Welcome and guide new joiners and visitors, and escalate urgent matters to the right teams.

  • Coordinate external events and visits hosted at the site, from catering and set-up to access and scheduling, and be present on the day.

  • Own the appearance of the site through regular walk-throughs, ensuring corrective actions are completed and spaces are prepared ahead of visits.

  • Collect feedback from site teams and drive improvements to the on-site offer and visitor experience with Marketing and Security.

Candidate Requirements

  • Proven experience managing service providers in facility management, general services, workplace, events or an equivalent field.

  • Hands-on approach and a strong operational presence on site.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities at once.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, at ease with all levels of the organization.

  • Attention to detail and high standards of presentation.

  • Reactivity, autonomy and a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience in an industrial or production environment, or in coordinating external events or visits, is a plus.

  • Knowledge of industrial site safety rules and familiarity with a ticketing tool are a plus.

  • Fluent French and professional English required.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: AI Product Builder - BeReal
description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 1,000 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta.

Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life.
